$comment: DEVDEPARTMENT hook wiring. Merge the `hooks` object below into the project's .claude/settings.json (create it if absent). Paths are project-relative; Claude Code runs hook commands from the project root with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set. Set DEVTEAM_UNIT=GB|CX in a builder harness environment to activate territory enforcement for that unit; unset/ORCH sessions get secret-scan + session lifecycle only. Hook ORDER inside a matcher is load-bearing: territory-firewall (may this unit write here?) runs before gateguard (does it understand the file?), so a unit outside its territory is told about the boundary rather than sent to investigate a file it may not touch. Gateguard is builders-only by default — see docs/GATEGUARD.md.
